Spells:
Align Weapon (Devil Evil2 Tran): Touched weapon gains a choice of chaotic, evil, good, or lawful alignment (save Will negates) for 20 min
Blasphemy (Devil Evil7 Evoc): Inflicts on nonevil creatures within 40' a set of effects: banishment for 24 hr (save Will -4 negates) on extraplanar creatures; killed or destroyed on creatures with up to 10 HD (save Will inflicts 3d6+20 HP); paralyzed for 1d10 min on creatures with up to 15 HD (save Will inflicts paralyzed for 1 rd); -2d6 Strength for 2d4 rd on creatures with up to 19 HD (save Will half); dazed for 1 rd on creatures with up to 20 HD (save Will negates)
Command (Devil Evil1 Ench): R75' Target obeys a command to approach, drop, fall, flee, or halt (save Will negates) for 1 rd
Dispel Good (Devil Evil5 Abju): Gives self a +4 deflection bonus to Armor Class vs. good creatures for 20 rd; can end the spell early with a touch that dismisses a good creature (save Will negates), a good spell, or a spell cast by a good caster
Expeditious Retreat (Exploration1 Tran): Gives self a +30' land Speed for 20 min
Find The Path (Exploration6 Divi): Touched knows the most direct route to a specified location (save Will negates) for 200 min
Fly (Exploration3 Tran): Touched gains a 60' fly Speed and +10 Fly skill for 20 min, then floats downward 60' per rd for 1d6 rd (save Will negates)
Greater Teleport (Exploration7 Conj): Transports self, touched objects (save Will negates), and 6 willing targets any distance with no chance of error
Locate Creature (Exploration4 Divi): Reveals the direction of a visualized creature or kind of creature found within 1200' for 200 min; a sheet of lead blocks the spell
Locate Object (Exploration2 Divi): Reveals the direction of a visualized object or kind of object found within 1200' for 20 min; a sheet of lead blocks the spell
Phase Door (Exploration8 Conj): Allows self and specified creatures to pass through a 5'x8'x40' section of wood, stone, or plaster a total of 10 times
Planar Binding (Devil Evil6 Conj): Traps 1-3 extraplanar creatures with up to 12 HD total in a Magic Circle (save Will negates) until they perform a task (opposed Charisma allows refusal), or escape via SR, dimensional travel, or a DC 27 Charisma check
Suggestion (Devil Evil3 Ench): R75' Target follows a reasonable suggestion (save Will negates) for up to 20 hr
Summon Monster IX (Devil Evil9 Conj): R75' Summons 1 9th-level, 1d3 8th-level, or 1d4+1 lower-level creatures that fight foes and obey orders for 20 rd
Teleport (Exploration5 Conj): Transports self, touched objects (save Will negates), and 6 willing targets up to 2000 miles; greater familiarity with the destination improves accuracy
Unholy Aura (Devil Evil8 Abju): 20 creatures within 20' inflict -1d6 Strength on successful good attackers (save Fortitude negates) and gain a +4 deflection bonus to Armor Class, +4 saves, SR 25 vs. good spells and casters, an additional +2 save to suppress existing mental control and possession, and immunity to new attempts to control or possess, for 20 rd
Unholy Blight (Devil Evil4 Evoc): R300' Good creatures in a 20' radius suffer 5d8 HP (or 10d6 HP to outsiders) and are sickened for 1d4 rd (save Will half HP only); neutral creatures suffer half HP only (save Will half)
World Wave (Exploration9 Tran): Allows self and 20 designated creatures to ride a 20'x200' section of natural terrain that forms a 30' wave for 20 rd or a 5' swell for 20 hr, moves 240' per rd, and inflicts 6d6 (wave) or 1d6 (swell) HP bludgeoning to non-natural objects, with constructs and undead sufferng double
